examples.title: Greeting
examples.summary: Call greet for Ada and let Python use its default Hello prefix.
limitations: The bindings call the embedded Python implementation and do not make it faster.
Regeneration imports trusted Python source with the native generator.

examples.title: Shapes
examples.summary: Use a generated subclass constructor and inherited method through Rust.
limitations: Generated wrappers still invoke Python methods at runtime.
Regeneration imports trusted Python source with the native generator.

examples.title: Palette
examples.summary: Pass generated enum values into a Python function and inspect its result.
limitations: Python enum objects remain part of the runtime call path.
Regeneration requires Python 3.14.2 and trusted fixture source.
